changes: Closed accessible AIS disclosure replaces default obstructive and dismissible serverless banner. Moves into Layers after asynchronous mounting; unavailable/provider details remain accessible.
Neutral AIS vessels display label; serverless flag and enabled layer do not imply live or global coverage.

Export describeAisAvailability(stats, {now}) requires accepted recent positions plus healthy status; explicitly handles missing key, unavailable, stale, replay, errors and empty data. Existing HUD summary API unchanged.

Export installIncidentDiagnostics({document,panel,toggles,legend,hiddenNote,dataPanel}), with closed Diagnostic info details and original toggles/legend moved under .data-panel-inner. Preserves state/listeners, waits for late host, and returns idempotent destroy restoring original order.
integrationRequired: Coordinator must import/install diagnostics in src/incidents/ui/index.js and call its destroy during UI teardown. Unowned index and CSS were not edited. Optional getAisStats callback to installServerlessNotice supplies actual provider stats.
